items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: Neighborhood children come down there like T.V. Thomas, Eric Williams, and that big, big town at the, when out of California was healthy and died out there.

ctx.x: of Earl Humphrey, Moetze 28th 1963. I'd just like to have it on the tape. In case we get the box mixed up. You were telling me about the bass. You took up the bass huh? Yeah. You couldn't make money huh?

No, well I didn't. Family bass. We had the rehearsal every Friday. There wasn't nobody but me and Bill, my granddaddy and my aunt. Because he taught, you know, his teachings. Neighborhood children come down there like T.V. Thomas, Eric Williams, and that big, big town at the, when out of California was healthy and died out there. In our front room there, we had to have about an hour in the air for a whistle every Friday night. And the people on the front, all that neighborhood up around there, wide end colored,…
